referral.reason_text: Iron deficiency anaemia, Hb 98. Fatigue worse since March.

deciding.fast_track_met: Age 54 is under the 60 threshold for iron deficiency anaemia, so the age-based criterion is not met. No FIT result or dysphagia is recorded.
deciding.vetting_outcome: Results are complete and recent, showing Hb 108 and ferritin 6, with three comorbidities and aspirin use. Expedited booking is better supported than routine, though the referral is not fast-track.
deciding.first_contact: Three comorbidities and aspirin use favour a face-to-face consultant visit. A normal colonoscopy 2023-11 and no red flags leave a written advice letter plausible.
deciding.clinical_urgency: Fatigue has been worse since March, which is borderline for documented deterioration within eight weeks. No red flags are recorded, so level 0 or 1 is both defensible.
deciding.record_agreement: Reason_text quotes Hb 98 against 108 in results. Aspirin appears in exam_note but not in meds. Whether these count as one or two material mismatches is open.
